what_to_order: Nikujiru chuka soba (soy-sauce ramen with a meaty broth) and the house nikujiru gyoza; at lunch, the all-toppings mazesoba or tsukemen (about 1300)
tourist_tip: No credit cards; PayPay accepted. 22 seats.

name_ja: 刀削麺荘 唐家 秋葉原本店
hours: 11:30-20:00 (LO 19:45); a 2024 report says it sometimes closes earlier
closed_days: None (may close a few days at New Year)
what_to_order: Mala (spicy Sichuan pepper) knife-cut noodles; the shop highlights its own noodles and xiangla sauce
tourist_tip: Small 10-seat shop. Credit cards not accepted. Hours may vary, so arrive well before closing.

what_to_order: Steak curry (the dish the shop is known for) or a quick bowl of soba
tourist_tip: Very cheap and fast, open from early morning to late night by JR Akihabara. Credit cards not accepted. 30 seats.

what_to_order: Tempura soba: tendama (tempura and egg) soba, shungiku (chrysanthemum greens) tempura or squid tempura soba
tourist_tip: Long-running stand-up soba shop in Kanda-Izumicho; the counter is standing only. PayPay accepted; no credit cards. Daytime only.

hours: Weekdays from 7:00 into the afternoon (Retty also mentions evening opening from about 18:00); Saturdays shorter morning hours. Exact current hours unknown
what_to_order: Ika soba: soba topped with a crispy squid kakiage (the shop's famous dish)
tourist_tip: 11 counter spots. Cash only (no cards). Opens early, good for breakfast before the shops open.

name_ja: 手打ち蕎麦切り 匠
what_to_order: Ai-mori (two kinds of hand-cut soba on one tray) or tori-gobo (chicken and burdock) soba
tourist_tip: A sit-down hand-made soba shop rather than a quick stand. Credit cards accepted (Amex listed). No counter seats.

what_to_order: Lunch set meals such as tonjiru (pork miso soup) teishoku or niku-dofu (simmered beef and tofu) teishoku, alongside soba
tourist_tip: Cash only. Works as an izakaya in the evening, so dinner costs more than lunch.

name_en: Sanuki Udon Ibukiya Seimen Akihabara UDX
name_ja: 讃岐うどん 伊吹や製麺 秋葉原UDX店
what_to_order: Toriten (chicken tempura) udon or udon with a soft-cooked egg; whitebait rice bowl sets
tourist_tip: Chain shop inside the Akihabara UDX building, 57 seats, so easy for groups. Payment info conflicts on Retty (cards maybe not accepted, PayPay listed); bring cash.

name_en: Curry no Shimin Alba Akihabara (main store)
name_ja: カレーの市民 アルバ 秋葉原本店
what_to_order: Kanazawa-style thick curry with a fried topping such as pork cutlet; Hanton curry and the Alba curry are also popular orders
tourist_tip: No credit cards; only Rakuten Edy as e-money. 22 seats including 9 at the counter. Takeout available.

what_to_order: European-style curry with slow-cooked beef tendon (gyusuji)
tourist_tip: Back-alley shop run by one person since 2016, so it can close unexpectedly. Cash only (2026 report).

name_ja: スパイス パレット
hours: Mon-Sat 11:30-15:00 (LO 14:30); the shop announced longer and evening hours from autumn 2026, so check before going
what_to_order: Keema chicken curry (its most popular plate)
tourist_tip: Second-floor shop (opened 2019). PayPay accepted. May close early when sold out.

what_to_order: Twin curry: two curries on one plate (beef curry plus a Sri Lankan-style curry)
tourist_tip: Credit cards not accepted. 24 seats with a counter. Open through the afternoon without a break.

what_to_order: Tekkadon (raw tuna rice bowl); sashimi set meal
tourist_tip: Weekdays only. Cash only (no cards). 36 seats with counter and tatami. Reservations accepted.

what_to_order: Chicken nanban set meal (Miyazaki-style fried chicken with sweet vinegar and tartar sauce); a three-kind chicken nanban set is offered at lunch
tourist_tip: PayPay accepted. Dinner service is short (18:00-20:00).

what_to_order: Gyukatsu (beef cutlet) set meal; a two-cutlet 260 g set was reported at 2760 yen (2023), and sets with mugitoro (grated yam over barley rice) are also offered
tourist_tip: Basement shop (B1F). No credit cards; PayPay accepted.

closed_days: Sunday, public holidays; also New Year and summer holidays
what_to_order: Eel over rice: lunch-only una-don (reported 1800 yen in 2025, limited to about 20 servings), jo-unaju set (reported 4800 yen in 2024), grilled eel liver
tourist_tip: The cheap lunch una-don is limited in number, so arrive early. Amex and PayPay accepted.

what_to_order: Gourmet burgers such as the Super Cheese Burger and the Luther Burger with a doughnut bun (both reported at 2240 yen), plus milkshakes, including sake or rum milkshakes (1000 yen)
tourist_tip: Upper floor (5F per hamoni) of the Kokusai 6163 building. Visa, Mastercard, JCB, Diners and PayPay accepted.

genre: Kissaten (retro cafe) with hamburg steak lunches
what_to_order: Hamburg steak topped with a fried egg (reported 950 yen in 2023) and the Japanese wagyu beef lunch set (reported 920 yen); lunch sets come with coffee or tea
tourist_tip: Basement (B1F) cafe. Tabelog lists no cards, no e-money and no QR payments, so bring cash. No reservations. Opening hours are not published online.

what_to_order: Yakiniku grilled beef; the shop is also listed for rice bowls, sashimi-style meat and kakigori shaved ice
tourist_tip: 2nd floor, dinner only. Reservations accepted. Amex and PayPay accepted.

hours: Mon-Fri 16:00-22:30 (LO 21:30); Sat 14:00-22:00 (LO 21:00); occasional takeout lunch only
what_to_order: Beef tongue cuts grilled at the table, including salted tongue and miso tongue
tourist_tip: Basement (B1F), 36 seats, non-smoking. No credit cards. Diners report it books up with set seating times, so reserve ahead. Takeout lunches are announced on its website or X.

what_to_order: Hamburg steak in 180 g or 300 g sizes with sauces like pepper sauce; fried-egg topping and hamburg curry also offered
tourist_tip: Credit cards accepted (Amex listed). Reservations accepted.

name_ja: やきとん酒場 秋葉原とら八
what_to_order: Charcoal-grilled pork skewers made from pork delivered that morning; the shop recommends simmered cabbage with miso and tonpeiyaki (pork omelette)
tourist_tip: Credit cards and PayPay accepted. Online and phone reservations accepted. Horse-meat dishes are also on the menu.

name_ja: 明神下 神田川 本店
what_to_order: Grilled eel (kabayaki / unaju)
tourist_tip: About 370 m from Suehirocho; also about 8-9 minutes on foot from Ochanomizu Station. Visa and Mastercard accepted; no e-money or QR payments. Reservations accepted.

name_ja: Vault coffee（ヴォルトコーヒー）
what_to_order: Ogura toast (red-bean toast, reported 600 yen in 2025), gorgonzola cheese toast, King Arthur blend coffee
tourist_tip: 3rd floor of Liberty Building No.5. No credit cards; PayPay accepted. Open late (until 23:00).

what_to_order: Fresh fruit juices and cut fruit (pineapple, papaya, raspberry, kiwi; reviewers report items around 200-300 yen); roasted sweet potatoes also sold
tourist_tip: Opens early on weekdays (8:00). Payment methods are not published; carry cash.

name_ja: フライング・スコッツマン 秋葉原店
what_to_order: Thick hotcakes such as salted caramel, chocolate and rare cheese, seasonal chestnut; also terrine chocolat and kakigori
tourist_tip: 3rd floor, 20 seats, non-smoking. PayPay accepted; Retty is inconsistent about credit cards.

what_to_order: Omakase sushi course (one diner reported 13200 yen including all-you-can-drink; extras like shirako or raw oysters cost more)
tourist_tip: Opened around 2025 (first Retty review March 2025). Hours and payment methods are not published on Retty; book ahead.

what_to_order: Seafood small plates such as maguro-butsu (tuna chunks) and tako-butsu (octopus), agedashi tofu, plus regional sake
tourist_tip: 3rd floor; weekdays only. Amex and PayPay accepted.

what_to_order: Ishikura teishoku set (reported 1300 yen in 2024), grilled salted mackerel, tempura and ginger-pork lunch sets
tourist_tip: Formerly called Akihabara Robata. Amex and PayPay accepted.

what_to_order: House karaage fried chicken with a curry flavor; negitoro-don set (reported 1300 yen)
tourist_tip: No credit cards. Also about 5 minutes from JR Akihabara.

name_ja: 鶏喜鶏喜（ちょきちょき）
what_to_order: Yakitori and the shop's recommended special furofuki daikon (simmered radish); draft beer 420 yen
tourist_tip: Basement (B1F). No credit cards; PayPay accepted. Online booking available.

name_ja: ミルクスタンド 秋葉原店
genre: Milk and bread stand on the station platform
station: Akihabara (JR Sobu Line platform 5, inside ticket gates)
hours: Sat 8:30-19:30 per hamoni; other days unknown
what_to_order: Bottled milk from about 15 dairies around Japan (one listing shows Minna no Gyunyu at 180 yen), with bread
tourist_tip: Inside the JR ticket gates, mid-platform on the Sobu Line (toward Shinjuku), so you need a JR ticket or IC card. Standing stand run by Osawa Gyunyu.

what_to_order: The house specialty harami (skirt) steak and ajillo, both featured in the shop's courses
tourist_tip: Lunch is currently suspended. Visa, Mastercard and PayPay accepted. Courses with 2-2.5 hours of all-you-can-drink are 5000-5500 yen.

name_ja: たつみ屋 ヨドバシAKIBA
what_to_order: Sukiyaki set meal (beef-belly sukiyaki teishoku reported at 1100 yen)
tourist_tip: On the 8th-floor restaurant floor of Yodobashi Akiba. Credit cards accepted.

what_to_order: The shop's top pick: kurobuta (black pork) skewers; also simmered pork belly and nikomi stew
tourist_tip: No credit cards; PayPay accepted. Online and phone reservations accepted.

what_to_order: Sashimi, yakitori and chicken dishes at a standing counter
tourist_tip: Standing bar. No credit cards; diners report cash-on-delivery (pay as you order).

name_ja: 東京カフェレストラン フレスカ
what_to_order: Omurice with ketchup or hayashi sauce (ketchup omurice lunch reported 1200 yen with drink), Napolitan spaghetti, scallop rigatoni gratin
tourist_tip: Basement (B1F). Visa, Amex, Diners, JCB, PayPay and Rakuten Edy accepted. Reservations accepted.

name_en: The French Toast Factory Yodobashi Akiba
name_ja: The French Toast Factory ヨドバシAkiba店
what_to_order: FTF Classic Toast (reported 1200 yen in late 2024) with the original blend coffee (490 yen)
tourist_tip: On the 8th-floor restaurant floor of Yodobashi Akiba. Credit cards and PayPay accepted.

what_to_order: Western-style kakiage (yofu kakiage), a fritter fried in pork fat, is the dish TV Tokyo singled out; omurice (about 900 yen) is the other well-known order.
tourist_tip: Founded in 1907. Cash only (no cards, e-money or QR per Tabelog). Dinner service is short and ends at 19:30.

genre: Western sweets and bakery (cakes, apple pie), takeout
hours: Tabelog: Mon-Sat 10:00-19:00, Sun and holidays 10:00-17:30 (Chiyoda tourism site lists Mon-Sat from 9:00)
closed_days: None (open daily); New Year hours vary
what_to_order: Apple pie and the strawberry sandwich shortcake (both listed by the Chiyoda City tourism site); baumkuchen is also a known item.
tourist_tip: Founded in 1884. The eat-in cafe is suspended per Tabelog, so plan on takeout. Cards accepted (Visa, Mastercard, JCB, Amex, Diners); no e-money or QR.

genre: Inari sushi and norimaki, mostly takeout
hours: Tabelog: Mon and Wed-Fri 7:30-17:00, Sat/Sun/holidays 7:30-16:00 (Chiyoda tourism site and Retty list 7:30-18:00); closes early when sold out
what_to_order: Inari sushi and the shop's 'Shinoda' assortment of inari with kanpyo norimaki; Osaka-style pressed sushi and chakin-zushi are also sold.
tourist_tip: Founded in 1902. Cash only (no cards per Tabelog and Retty). Mostly takeout; the basement eat-in space has been suspended at times. Items can sell out.

name_ja: 神田きくかわ 神田店
station: Kanda (Ginza Line Exit 5; about 2 min from JR East Exit)
hours: Tue-Fri 11:00-21:00 (last order 20:00); Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00-20:30 (last order 19:30)
closed_days: Monday (open on public holidays, then closed the following Tuesday)
what_to_order: Unaju (grilled eel over rice in a lacquered box), which the shop calls its signature.
tourist_tip: Cards accepted (no e-money or QR). The menu beyond unaju is limited. Online booking available; same-day cancellations are not allowed.

hours: Mon-Fri 11:00-23:00 (last order 22:30); Sat 12:00-23:00 (last order 22:30); Sun and holidays 12:00-22:00 (last order 21:30)
what_to_order: Lamb dishes (the shop's recommendation) such as lamb skewers and lamb dumplings, and the charcoal hot pot set.
tourist_tip: Opened in 2000; the original shop of the Ajibo group. Cards and e-money accepted, no QR. Parties of 1-3 reserve by phone. A 10% service charge is listed on Tabelog.

what_to_order: Omakase course (22,000 yen incl. tax) using chickens from the restaurant's own farm, such as Miyazaki Jitokko, Hinai Jidori and Nagoya Cochin.
tourist_tip: Only 8 counter seats; online reservations only. Cards accepted; 10% service charge.

hours: Mon-Fri 11:00-15:00 (last order 14:45) and 17:30-20:00 (last order 19:30); Sat 11:00-15:00; may close early when noodles run out
what_to_order: Tori-chikuwa tempura udon (chicken and fish-cake tempura), which the shop names as its most popular dish; curry udon is also on the menu. A large 500 g portion costs nothing extra.
tourist_tip: No reservations. Cards, IC transit cards and QR payments (PayPay and others) accepted. Saturday is lunch only.

hours: Mon-Fri and public holidays 11:30-15:00 (last order 14:45) and 18:00-21:00 (last order 20:45)
what_to_order: Clam tsukemen and shrimp-wonton shoyu ramen are the dishes that appear most in Tabelog reviews and photos (the shop info names no signature dish).
tourist_tip: No cards, e-money or QR per Tabelog, so bring cash. No reservations. Closed on weekends.

hours: Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri 11:00-15:00 (last order 14:30) and 18:00-22:00 (last order 21:30); Wed and Sat 11:00-15:00 (last order 14:30)
what_to_order: Combination curry (about 1,800 yen per a Tabelog photo), with a choice of spice level.
tourist_tip: Cash only (no cards, e-money or QR). No reservations. Dinner only on Mon, Tue, Thu and Fri.

genre: Curry (Indian-style) at lunch, izakaya at night
hours: Curry lunch Tue-Fri 11:30-13:30 (until sold out); izakaya Mon-Sat 18:00-22:00
what_to_order: Chicken curry and nasu-tomato (eggplant and tomato) curry, or both on one plate, are the items most mentioned in Tabelog reviews and photos.
tourist_tip: Cash only. On the 5th floor. Curry is a short weekday lunch (Tue-Fri) that sells out; evenings are an izakaya with a 660 yen cover charge.

hours: Mon-Sat and holidays: lunch 11:30-14:00 (last order 13:30), dinner 18:00-21:30 (last order 20:30); no lunch on some days
what_to_order: Shark fin soup and the seasonal Shanghai hairy crab courses (October-December), both highlighted by the restaurant.
tourist_tip: Lunch is cash only; dinner takes cards and adds a 10% service charge. 100% cancellation fee on the day. On the 2nd floor.

closed_days: Friday, Saturday, Sunday and public holidays
what_to_order: Cinnamon toast, or a cake set with homemade New York cheesecake or apple pie, with the blend coffee (items shown in Tabelog photos and reviews).
tourist_tip: Cash only. Non-smoking, 20 seats. Open Monday to Thursday only; not for children under 12. About 3 min from Awajicho Station.

hours: Reservation-only seatings: lunch 11:15-13:45, dinner 18:00-20:45; per Tabelog, dinner Mon-Thu and lunch plus dinner on Fri; schedule not fixed
what_to_order: Biryani, the restaurant's specialty.
tourist_tip: Reservation only through TableCheck; slots open at 12:00 one week ahead and fill fast. In a basement (B1F). Cards, IC cards and PayPay accepted.

closed_days: No regular closing day; occasional days off announced each month
what_to_order: Katsuobushi-kombu water tsukemen (noodles served in bonito-kelp water with a dipping sauce), with the shrimp and pork wonton topping; a hot 'tsuke-dantan' version is offered in cold months (all named in the shop info).
tourist_tip: Cash only per Tabelog. No reservations. Also about 3 min from Awajicho Station.

name_en: Shio Shoga Ramen MANNISH Awajicho Honten
name_ja: 塩生姜らー麺専門店 MANNISH 淡路町本店
hours: Mon-Fri 11:00-23:00 (last order 22:45); Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00-15:00; hours may change
what_to_order: Salt-ginger ramen (shio shoga ramen), the shop's specialty; the wonton version also shows up often in Tabelog photos.
tourist_tip: Cash only per Tabelog. 11 counter seats, non-smoking. Weekends and holidays are lunch only.

name_ja: 鶏と酎ハイ とり巣
hours: Mon-Fri 17:00-23:00 (food last order 22:00); Sat 15:00-22:00 (food last order 21:00)
closed_days: Sunday and public holidays (open when a holiday falls on Saturday)
what_to_order: Assorted yakitori platter, pork belly with sansho salt and grilled eggplant dengaku, with one of the house chuhai highballs (all named by the shop).
tourist_tip: Opened June 2024. 400 yen (plus tax) appetizer charge. Cards and PayPay accepted. Groups of 3+ should pick table seats when booking.

hours: Mon-Fri 11:00-14:00 and 17:00-23:00 (last order 22:00); Saturday and holidays listed as 11:00-22:00 (Tabelog also shows 17:00-22:00)
what_to_order: Nodoguro (blackthroat seaperch), which the restaurant calls its signature, with Japanese sake; weekday lunch sets cost much less.
tourist_tip: Cards accepted (no e-money or QR). Book dinner online.

what_to_order: Dango (sanfuku dango) and amazake, the items most mentioned on Tabelog.
tourist_tip: The in-store cafe is temporarily suspended (aging building), so treat it as takeout. Visa, PayPay and Rakuten Pay accepted. About 4 min from Kanda Station too.

name_ja: ディル コーヒー パーラー
what_to_order: unknown (Tabelog photos show an Americano and carrot cake)
tourist_tip: Opened March 2024 on two floors. Cards, e-money and QR accepted. No reservations. Walk time estimated from the 295 m distance on Tabelog.

hours: Mon-Fri 11:00-14:00 and 17:00-18:30; Sat 11:00-14:00; may close early when sold out
what_to_order: Zaru soba, tori-jiru seiro (cold soba with a hot chicken dipping broth) and ten-seiro (with tempura) are the dishes shown most on Tabelog.
tourist_tip: Cash only (no cards, e-money or QR). No reservations. Evening service is short (until 18:30).

what_to_order: House-made soba from stone-ground buckwheat and the course with two-color soba; the shop also lists rare sake such as Juyondai, Jikon and Aramasa.
tourist_tip: In a basement (B1F). Cards accepted. After 17:00 a 10% service charge and an appetizer fee apply. Course bookings carry a 100% same-day cancellation fee.

what_to_order: Omu-hayashi (omurice with hayashi sauce) and hamburg steak, the dishes shown most on Tabelog.
tourist_tip: Cash only (no cards, e-money or QR). On the 2nd floor. Tabelog remarks say dinner bookings are limited to two groups a day.

name_ja: 手打蕎麦 松竹庵 ます川
what_to_order: Tempura lunch course (5,200 yen) or omakase lunch course (6,500 yen); at dinner the omakase tempura course (16,000 yen). Prices exclude tax.
tourist_tip: Cards accepted; 5% service charge. 100% cancellation fee on the day, and lunch bookings are cancelled if you are more than 15 min late without calling.

name_en: Kanda Coffee En Kanda North Exit
name_ja: 神田珈琲園 神田北口店
what_to_order: Blend coffee (about 650 yen per a Tabelog photo) and the breakfast menu.
tourist_tip: Under the railway tracks right by the North Exit. 1F is non-smoking, 2F allows smoking. IC transit cards (Suica etc.) accepted; no credit cards or QR.

hours: Mon, Sat, Sun 11:00-19:00; Tue-Fri 11:00-21:00; until sold out
what_to_order: 'Black' shoyu ramen and the white chicken paitan soba, both mentioned in several Tabelog reviews.
tourist_tip: In a basement (B1F). Cash only per Tabelog. No reservations. Closes when soup runs out.

name_ja: 斎藤コーヒー店 内神田店
closed_days: Sunday, public holidays and New Year
what_to_order: Coffee (for example the Wiener coffee) with an egg sandwich or egg toast, items shown in Tabelog menu photos.
tourist_tip: Cash only. Non-smoking since July 2018.

hours: 11:00-21:00 (LO 20:30); Monday listed as 11:00-16:00 on Retty; weekends may close early when curry runs out
closed_days: Tuesday (next day if Tuesday is a holiday); New Year holidays
what_to_order: European-style curry (beef, chicken or seafood) with your choice of spice level, served with potatoes on the side
tourist_tip: Cash only. 2nd floor. Running since 1982. Tabelog says weekday dinners (from 17:00) can be booked; weekends are walk-in only

name_ja: ライスカレー まんてん
hours: Mon-Fri 11:00-20:00, Sat 11:00-16:00; closes when the rice runs out
closed_days: Sunday, public holidays, some Saturdays (2nd and 4th per Tabelog)
what_to_order: Katsu curry or the jumbo curry; many people add a fried shumai topping
tourist_tip: Cash only. 14 counter seats. Open since 1981. Also about 7 min from JR Suidobashi (East Exit)

what_to_order: Dorayaki (about 300 per piece in a 2023 report), mame-daifuku, and the turtle-shaped monaka 'Monakame'
tourist_tip: Takeout only, no seating. Japanese sweets shop founded in 1905. Payment methods unknown, bring cash

hours: Mon-Fri 10:00-20:00, Sat and holidays 12:00-19:00 (Tabelog; Retty lists weekdays until 22:30)
what_to_order: Trois Blend coffee (650), coffee jelly (650), gratin toast
tourist_tip: Basement cafe open since 1976. Non-smoking. Tabelog lists cards and IC cards accepted; Retty lists PayPay. A queue can form before opening

hours: Mon-Fri 11:00-18:00, Sat and holidays 11:00-17:00 (closing time can vary)
what_to_order: Ramen with half fried rice set (about 800-850 in 2024 reports); plain ramen was about 500
tourist_tip: Cash only (no cards). Counter seating. Closes around 17:00-18:00, so it is a lunch or early-dinner stop

hours: 9:00-14:00; closes early when soup runs out
what_to_order: The dashi ramen; the shop also runs rotating limited-edition bowls
tourist_tip: Morning and lunch only. 9 counter seats. Cards not accepted

what_to_order: Ginger shoyu ramen (about 1050); chashu ginger shoyu ramen (about 1350); two-color tsukemen
tourist_tip: Ticket machine, cash only. 12 counter seats. No reservations. Open Sundays

name_ja: 三幸園 白山通り店
what_to_order: Large pan-fried gyoza and nira (garlic chive) soba; curry fried rice is also popular
tourist_tip: No credit cards; PayPay accepted. Open late into the night on weekdays. Closed Saturdays (unusual). Online booking via Hot Pepper

name_ja: 源来酒家 神保町店
what_to_order: Mapo-men (noodles topped with mapo tofu), the house specialty; beef tendon mapo noodles in extra-hot
tourist_tip: Cards and PayPay accepted. Courses (4400 and 5500) can be booked online via Hot Pepper. Also 4 min from Kudanshita

what_to_order: Fried rice (about 800) or the half-fried-rice-and-ramen set (about 1000); mapo noodles also on the menu
tourist_tip: Cash only (no cards). Old-style neighborhood Chinese diner

what_to_order: Shanghai hairy crab dishes in season, Chinese-style paiko (pork cutlet) curry rice, dim sum
tourist_tip: Founded 1946. Reopened in May 2025 after renovation. Cards accepted. Large Shaoxing wine list

name_ja: スープカレー屋 鴻 神田駿河台店
hours: 10:30-20:00 per Tabelog (edited Feb 2026); Retty shows 11:00-15:30 and 17:00-20:00
what_to_order: Kuroge wagyu waterless cheese keema curry, served as a dark and a red version on one plate (about 1650); red or black soup curry
tourist_tip: Cash only. Dinner reservations possible, not at lunch. Also about 7 min from JR Ochanomizu (Ochanomizubashi Exit)

what_to_order: Keema curry or the chicken-mince dry curry
tourist_tip: Cash only. No reservations. 15 seats, tables may be shared. Sell-outs and temporary closures are posted on Facebook and the shop blog

hours: Mon-Sat 11:30-15:30 (LO 15:00); may close on some holidays and seasons
what_to_order: Chicken curry or the two-curry plate; there is also a monthly special
tourist_tip: Lunch only. 4th floor, 15 seats. Cards and IC cards accepted, no QR payment. No reservations. About 5-6 min from JR Ochanomizu too

what_to_order: Kosetoh Blend coffee (600); cafe au lait served in a bowl
tourist_tip: Cash only, no reservations. 2nd floor. Open since 1980. No bread or food menu on weekends. Walk down the hill from JR Ochanomizu (Ochanomizubashi Exit) toward Yasukuni-dori

what_to_order: Blend coffee (800) with the tart of the day (350) or homemade cheesecake
tourist_tip: Cash only, no reservations. Smoking allowed at all seats. 2nd floor on a quiet back street

name_ja: 茶房 神田伯剌西爾
what_to_order: Kanda Blend coffee and the homemade rare cheesecake; self-roasted beans are sold to take home
tourist_tip: Basement under a bookshop building. In Jimbocho since 1972. Cards accepted per Retty. Has smoking and non-smoking sections

name_ja: 石釜 ベイクブレッド 茶房 タムタム
what_to_order: Stone-oven baked hotcakes; stone-oven French toast
tourist_tip: Hotcakes take about 20-30 minutes to bake. No reservations, often busy. Cards, IC cards and PayPay accepted. Non-smoking

what_to_order: Blend or single-origin coffee (600) with butter toast (250) or the weekly homemade cake (350)
tourist_tip: Cash only (no cards). Smoking allowed at nearly all seats, and reports say under-20s are not admitted. Founded 1933

hours: Mon-Fri 11:00-16:00, 17:30-19:30; Sat 11:00-14:30; closes when sold out
what_to_order: Kake or kitsune udon with tempura toppings such as kashiwa-ten (chicken) or chikuwa-ten
tourist_tip: Cash only (no cards). Photos inside the shop are not allowed. 40 seats; lines at peak lunch

name_ja: レストラン カロリー
what_to_order: Calorie-yaki, the house signature plate (850 in 2023, since raised); pork fillet katsu can be added
tourist_tip: No credit cards. Same building as Kosetoh Coffee. Reported to date from 1953

what_to_order: Hamburg steak set (about 1150) or the menchi-katsu and ginger pork combo (about 1300)
tourist_tip: Cash only (no cards). Formerly Kitchen Gran; moved next door in the same building and took this name in June 2025

what_to_order: Beef tongue curry (about 850, large about 1150); pork curry (about 600)
tourist_tip: Cash only. Also about 7 min from Suidobashi

what_to_order: Lunch curry sets (about 1380-1880) with naan; butter chicken masala or chicken biryani. The shop offers 17 curries
tourist_tip: Basement. Cards (Amex listed) and PayPay accepted. Reservations taken

name_ja: 神保町やきそば 威風 みかさ 総本店
hours: From 11:00 until noodles sell out (one listing says limited to 150 servings)
what_to_order: Jimbocho yakisoba in sauce or shio (salt) style (about 1000); large size reported free
tourist_tip: Cash only. Buy a meal ticket first. No reservations. Go early because it closes when sold out

closed_days: Saturday, Sunday, public holidays (per Retty; confirm before visiting)
what_to_order: Lunch nigiri sets; sushi courses at dinner
tourist_tip: Cards and PayPay accepted (lunch specials cash only). Online reservations taken. Retty's shop info was last edited in 2020, so prices may be out of date. Also 3 min from Kudanshita

hours: 11:00-21:00 per Retty (Feb 2026); other listings show last close at 20:00-20:30
closed_days: None (open daily; closed Dec 31 and Jan 1)
what_to_order: Dozeu nabe (small loach simmered in a shallow iron pot, topped with chopped green onion)
tourist_tip: Credit cards accepted. Private rooms need a phone booking. Confirm closing time before a late visit, as listings differ.

closed_days: Wednesday (moves around holidays and Asakusa festival days)
what_to_order: Dozeu nabe, or the boneless version (nuki nabe); unaju (eel on rice) is also on the menu
tourist_tip: English menu available per Savor Japan. Cards accepted (Visa/Mastercard listed); no e-money or QR payment per Hot Pepper. On Kappabashi-dori, a short walk from Tawaramachi Exit 3.

hours: Lunch 11:30-14:00 Mon-Sat; dinner 17:00-20:00 Mon, Thu, Fri, Sat only; ends when rice runs out
closed_days: Sunday (no dinner on Tuesday and Wednesday)
what_to_order: Onigiri made to order, e.g. salmon, ume (pickled plum), tarako; lunch sets come with miso soup and pickles
tourist_tip: Cash only. Small counter shop; service ends when the rice is sold out. Tokyo's oldest onigiri specialist.

hours: Tue-Sat 11:30-14:00 (food LO 13:15) and 17:00-21:00 (food LO 20:00); Sat dinner to 20:30 per Michelin
what_to_order: Beef stew (the house favorite); omurice with demi-glace or ketchup
tourist_tip: Cards and transit IC cards accepted, QR payment not accepted. No online booking per Hot Pepper; book by phone. May stop seating before last order when busy.

what_to_order: Unaju (kabayaki eel over rice in a lacquer box)
tourist_tip: Cash only. Small traditional shop on a side street in Kaminarimon 2-chome.

hours: Lunch 12:00-14:00, dinner 18:00-20:30; Sunday and Tuesday lunch only (Sarai, 2026)
what_to_order: Seiro soba made from flour milled in-house, with tempura fried one piece at a time
tourist_tip: Credit cards accepted. Counter seating. Reservations recommended; dinner course bookable on TableCheck.

what_to_order: Tonkatsu set meal (loin or fillet)
tourist_tip: Bring cash: Tabelog lists cards, e-money and QR payment as not accepted (Retty lists Amex; confirm in person).

hours: 11:00-15:00 (LO 14:45), Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri, Sat; ends when sold out
closed_days: Wednesday, Sunday and public holidays (Sunday may also depend on fish supply)
what_to_order: Edomae tendon (large tempura bowl with seafood such as conger eel and prawn)
tourist_tip: Lunch only. No credit cards; PayPay accepted. Closes when ingredients run out, so come early.

name_ja: 浅草天麩羅 葵丸進
what_to_order: Tendon or a tempura set; tempura courses (e.g. Kaminarimon course 6500) for a bigger meal
tourist_tip: Cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Diners, JCB) and PayPay accepted. Courses can be booked online via Rakuten Gurunavi or by phone.

name_ja: 食事処 酒肴 浅草 水口
what_to_order: Teishoku (set meals) and diner classics; long menu of Japanese comfort food with drinks
tourist_tip: Credit cards only for bills of 5000 yen or more; PayPay not accepted. Opens early (10:00), handy before or after Senso-ji.

what_to_order: Unaju (grilled eel over rice)
tourist_tip: Credit cards accepted. Open on public holidays and Asakusa festival days.

what_to_order: Unaju; eel courses (e.g. Komagata course 17500, Maekawa full eel course 20000)
tourist_tip: Cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Diners, JCB) and PayPay accepted. Bookable online via Rakuten Gurunavi or by phone (03-3841-6314). Komagata 2-chome, by the Sumida River.

name_ja: モンブラン 浅草店
closed_days: Wednesday (if a holiday, open and closed the next day)
what_to_order: Hamburg steak (hambagu)
tourist_tip: PayPay accepted; card acceptance is listed inconsistently, so carry cash.

name_ja: 浅草むぎとろ 本店
genre: Mugitoro (barley rice with grated yam), kaiseki
what_to_order: Mugitoro: barley rice topped with grated yam; the weekday lunch buffet is the budget option
tourist_tip: Cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Diners, JCB) accepted. Weekday mugitoro buffet takes no reservations; the 3300 buffet has an 80-minute limit. Kaiseki courses can be booked.

hours: Mon, Wed-Fri 11:30-14:00 and 17:00-22:00; Sat, Sun, holidays 11:30-20:00
what_to_order: Tendon or a tempura set
tourist_tip: Credit cards accepted. Bookable by phone (03-3841-4015) or online via Hitosara.

name_ja: 中国手打拉麺 馬賊
what_to_order: Hand-pulled noodles, e.g. tantanmen (spicy sesame noodles); gyoza
tourist_tip: No credit cards; bring cash. Open all day, every day.

name_ja: 浅草 魚料理 遠州屋
closed_days: Sunday, public holidays and New Year
what_to_order: Lunch fish set meals (grilled or simmered fish, 880); unagi-don 980; seasonal fish courses at dinner
tourist_tip: Cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Diners, JCB) and PayPay accepted. Dinner courses bookable online or by phone. Address is Kotobuki 2-chome, right by Tawaramachi Station.

hours: Mon-Fri 14:00-2:00; Sat 12:00-2:00; Sun and holidays 12:00-24:00 (LO 30 min before close)
what_to_order: Salted beef tongue, harami (skirt steak) and kalbi
tourist_tip: Opens 14:00 on weekdays, noon on weekends; open until late. Cards accepted (Amex listed); e-money and QR reportedly not accepted. Phone 03-3845-0138.

what_to_order: Classic bistro dishes: French onion soup, fish quenelle, duck confit, steak frites
tourist_tip: Visa and Mastercard accepted; online booking asks for card details but you pay at the restaurant. In the Kannon-ura area, 4-10-6 Asakusa.

what_to_order: Chef Noboru Arai's French tasting menu
tourist_tip: Credit cards accepted. Fixed seating windows, so arrive on time. In the Kannon-ura area, 4-10-5 Asakusa.

name_ja: 釜めし・串焼きの麻鳥
what_to_order: Kamameshi (rice cooked to order in a small iron pot) and kushiyaki skewers
tourist_tip: Kamameshi is cooked to order, so expect a wait. Reservations taken for dinner only. Card acceptance is listed inconsistently; carry cash.

what_to_order: Tendon; kakiage tendon
tourist_tip: Daytime only. No credit cards; bring cash.

what_to_order: Tonkatsu set meal
tourist_tip: PayPay accepted; no card info listed, so carry cash.

what_to_order: Kamameshi (rice cooked to order in an iron pot)
tourist_tip: No credit cards; cash. North side of Asakusa (3-chome), behind Senso-ji. Kamameshi takes time to cook.

what_to_order: Tendon (prawn and conger eel tendon, kakiage tenju)
tourist_tip: PayPay accepted; card acceptance listed inconsistently, carry cash. About 9 minutes on foot from Tsukuba Express Asakusa Station.

what_to_order: Tempura and tendon
tourist_tip: Cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Diners, JCB) and PayPay accepted. Long opening hours, every day.

what_to_order: Dorayaki with black or white bean paste; also Kameju monaka and matsukaze
tourist_tip: Takeout only, cash only (no cards or QR pay). Across from Kaminarimon on Kaminarimon-dori; queues often form.

what_to_order: Mamekan (simmered red peas with agar jelly and syrup); also anmitsu, awa zenzai and kakigori
tourist_tip: Cash only. Small shop in the Kannon-ura backstreets north of Senso-ji; about 8 minutes from the Ginza Line Asakusa Station.

what_to_order: Imo-yokan (sweet potato yokan) and anko-dama (bean paste balls)
tourist_tip: Founded 1902. Takeout shop plus a tearoom; no reservations. Cards, e-money and QR pay accepted.

name_ja: 浅草 満願堂 オレンジ通り本店
what_to_order: Imo-kin (sweet potato kintsuba); also Edo kintsuba
tourist_tip: Sales counter only (no seating). Visa, Mastercard, JCB, Diners and PayPay accepted.

name_en: Suzukien Asakusa Honten (x Nanaya matcha gelato)
what_to_order: Matcha gelato made with Nanaya, in graded strengths up to the very strong Premium No.7
tourist_tip: Tea merchant's shop with 15 seats (eat-in upstairs). Cards, e-money and QR pay accepted. North-east of Senso-ji.

what_to_order: The house special nouilles (pasta), plus kissaten coffee
tourist_tip: Open very late, rare for Asakusa. No credit cards.

closed_days: Tuesday (some posts say Monday too; check)
what_to_order: Daigaku-imo (candied sweet potato) and kiriage (fried sweet potato sticks)
tourist_tip: Cash only, takeout only.

name_ja: 常盤堂雷おこし本舗 雷門本店
what_to_order: Kaminari okoshi (crunchy puffed-rice sweets), including salt and other flavors
tourist_tip: Right beside Kaminarimon. Credit cards and PayPay accepted. Good boxed souvenirs.

name_ja: かりんとう 小桜 浅草本店
what_to_order: Karinto in several styles (thin and thick black-sugar types), in small gift boxes
tourist_tip: Payment info conflicts between listings; bring cash. In the quieter streets north of Senso-ji.

name_ja: フルーツパーラーゴトー
closed_days: Wednesday (a June 2026 listing also shows Thursday closed; check)
what_to_order: Seasonal fruit parfait (fruit changes through the year); fresh fruit juice
tourist_tip: Run by a fruit shop; the parfait lineup changes with the season. Walk-in.

name_ja: 純喫茶 マウンテン
what_to_order: Kissaten classics such as Napolitan spaghetti, cream soda and parfaits
tourist_tip: PayPay accepted; card acceptance is unclear, so bring cash. Also about 4 minutes from Tawaramachi.

name_ja: 銀座ブラジル 浅草支店
what_to_order: Katsu sando (pork cutlet sandwich) with coffee
tourist_tip: Second floor. No credit cards.

closed_days: Sunday, plus summer and New Year breaks (sources differ on public holidays)
what_to_order: Shokupan (sandwich loaf) and rolls, the only two kinds of bread made
tourist_tip: Cash only, takeout only, no seats. Loaves often sell out; reserve online in advance.

what_to_order: Charcoal-grilled toast made with Pelican bread, ham-katsu sandwich, fruit sandwich
tourist_tip: Cafe of the Pelican bakery, a short walk south of the Tawaramachi crossing. Hours vary slightly between listings; check before going.

what_to_order: Lemon pie, the shop's specialty
tourist_tip: Cash only. Right by Tawaramachi Station.

what_to_order: Pudding and sake-paired sweets such as a sake affogato
tourist_tip: Evening-only on Wednesday and Thursday. Also 3 minutes from Tsukuba Express Asakusa.

name_ja: クレール ドゥ リュンヌ
what_to_order: Cakes and pastries such as mille-feuille, macarons and chocolatine
tourist_tip: Credit cards and PayPay accepted. Also about 5 minutes from Tawaramachi.

what_to_order: Thin mocha cookies, sweet potato scones and seasonal butter sandwiches
tourist_tip: Same building as Kissaten Hangetsu (Kuramae 4-31-11). Posts updates on Instagram.

what_to_order: Cream puffs and Victoria cake
tourist_tip: 2nd floor, 38 seats. Same building as Kashiya Shinonome.

name_ja: 結わえる 蔵前本店
what_to_order: Set meals with aged brown rice (nekashi genmai) and obanzai side dishes
tourist_tip: Healthy Japanese home-style food; online booking is available through AutoReserve.

what_to_order: Tendon and jo-tenju (tempura over rice); ten-sando (tempura sandwich)
tourist_tip: Payment info conflicts between listings; bring cash.

name_ja: パティスリー フォブス
what_to_order: Tarts (such as noisette-passion), mille-feuille and gaufrettes; kakigori in season
tourist_tip: Next door to Clair de Lune on the Kotobuki 3-chome block.

what_to_order: Cookies, muffins and lattes
tourist_tip: Order at the counter.

hours: 11:00-19:00 (listing shows one day only; check Instagram)
what_to_order: Freshly baked canneles; seasonal far Breton
tourist_tip: Takeout on the 1st floor, cafe seating on the 2nd.

what_to_order: The 'kitta yatsu' burger: the patty is cut in half and seared again on the griddle
tourist_tip: Opened in Asakusa in February 2024; online booking through AutoReserve.

station: Keisei Ueno; also Ueno-Hirokoji (Ginza Line) 3 min, JR Ueno Shinobazu Exit 5 min
closed_days: Monday (Tuesday if Monday is a holiday); New Year's Day
what_to_order: Hayashi rice, omurice or beef stew (hayashi rice and omurice are marked as recommended on the menu)
tourist_tip: On the 4th floor of the Kikuya Building. Cards, IC cards and PayPay accepted. Online booking is possible; daytime bookings have a time limit of 1 hour 20 minutes.

station: Keisei Ueno; JR/Ginza Line Ueno about 10 min
closed_days: Year-end and New Year holidays only
what_to_order: Hanakago-zen (lunch set served in a flower basket); tori-suki (chicken sukiyaki) courses
tourist_tip: Inside Ueno Park. Bookable lunch courses start at about 2950 yen on weekdays and about 4180 yen on weekends and holidays. Credit cards accepted; no e-money or QR payment. Book online (phone line listed as closed).

station: Keisei Ueno; also JR Okachimachi 4 min
what_to_order: Jumbo gyoza (6 pieces, about 800 yen, dine-in only); fried rice
tourist_tip: Cash only. No reservations. Near the Ameyoko railway arches; the separate Shoryu PART2 branch is closed.

station: Naka-Okachimachi (Hibiya Line); Ueno-Okachimachi (Oedo Line) about 170 m
what_to_order: Seiro soba (chilled soba on a bamboo tray), including duck or chicken seiro
tourist_tip: Cash only (no cards, e-money or QR). Closes at 18:00. Founded in 1859. Online booking is possible via Tabelog.

hours: Daily 8:00-19:00 (food LO 18:00, drinks LO 18:30); lunch from 11:00
what_to_order: Napolitan spaghetti, thick-cut toast or the morning set
tourist_tip: No cards or e-money; PayPay accepted. No reservations. Non-smoking. At its current location since 1975.

name_ja: アーンドラ・キッチン
station: JR Okachimachi (South Exit); Ueno-Hirokoji / Naka-Okachimachi Exit A6 2 min
what_to_order: Dosa, biryani, or a South Indian meals (thali-style) set
tourist_tip: In a basement (B1F). Cards accepted (VISA, JCB, AMEX); no e-money or QR listed. Vegetarian options. Online booking is possible.

what_to_order: Nigiri sushi sets, tuna dishes, or the Yoshiike Gozen (limited to 30 a day)
tourist_tip: On the 9th floor of the Yoshiike fish market building. Cards (JCB, AMEX), IC cards and PayPay accepted. Online booking is possible.

name_ja: 上野精養軒 本店レストラン
what_to_order: Hayashi rice or beef stew
tourist_tip: Inside Ueno Park. Lunch and afternoon only. Cards and PayPay accepted; no e-money.

station: JR Ueno (Hirokoji Exit); Ueno Exit 5b (Ginza/Hibiya Line) 1 min
what_to_order: Chocolate or fruit parfait, cream anmitsu, cream soda
tourist_tip: Cash only. No reservations. Smoking is allowed (there are some lower-smoke seats).

closed_days: Monday (Tuesday if Monday is a holiday)
what_to_order: Napolitan spaghetti and iced coffee
tourist_tip: Cash only. No reservations. In a basement (B1F) near Ameyoko.

name_ja: 東京とんかつ がぶう
what_to_order: Gabu omakase set (loin and fillet assortment, about 6600 yen)
tourist_tip: Opened April 2025. In a basement (B1F). Cards, IC cards and QR (PayPay, Alipay, WeChat Pay) accepted. Online booking via Tabelog.

closed_days: Monday (Tuesday if Monday is a holiday)
what_to_order: Tanmen (vegetable noodle soup) or fried rice
tourist_tip: Cash only. No reservations. Most dishes are 500-900 yen.

name_ja: 焼肉上野太昌園 本店
what_to_order: Silk yukke and scallion-wrapped salted beef tongue (both named by the shop as signatures)
tourist_tip: Founded in 1963. Cards, IC cards and QR (PayPay, Alipay, WeChat Pay) accepted. Book online. There is a separate Ueno Ekimae branch.

what_to_order: Cheap drinks with small plates such as grilled offal
tourist_tip: Standing only. Cash only. Smoking allowed. Opens from 7:00 in the morning. There is a separate No.2 branch nearby.

name_ja: カレー専門店 クラウンエース 上野店
what_to_order: Katsu curry (about 700 yen; cheese topping extra)
tourist_tip: Cash only. No reservations. Most curries are under 1000 yen. Sunday closes at 15:00.

name_ja: ラッフルズ カリー
what_to_order: Chicken or keema curry; a plate mixing two curries is available
tourist_tip: Cash only. No reservations. No dinner on Saturdays.

station: Inaricho (Ginza Line Exit 1); Ueno (Hibiya Line) Exit 1 5 min
what_to_order: Rich niboshi (dried sardine) soba
tourist_tip: Cash only. No reservations. Dinner only on Mon, Tue, Thu and Fri. In Higashi-Ueno, east of Ueno Station.

what_to_order: Tsukemen with two dipping sauces (tonkotsu-seafood and garlic soy)
tourist_tip: Cash only. No reservations. Closed days change month to month, so check before going.

what_to_order: Chiffon cake (banana or cinnamon), toast, or the morning set
tourist_tip: No reservations. Cards (JCB, AMEX), e-money and PayPay accepted. Non-smoking inside.

what_to_order: Tonkatsu set meal or katsu curry (about 1000 yen each at lunch)
tourist_tip: Cash only. No reservations. Weekdays only.

station: JR Okachimachi (North Exit); Ueno-Okachimachi Exit A5 about 60 m
what_to_order: Dim sum and xiaolongbao; Peking duck
tourist_tip: On the 8th floor of the Ueno C-road building. Cards and QR (PayPay, Alipay, WeChat Pay) accepted; no e-money. Online booking available.

station: Ueno (Ginza/Hibiya Line Exit 5a); JR Ueno 3 min
what_to_order: Pancake set and coffee
tourist_tip: Cash only. No reservations. A service charge is added. 1st floor non-smoking, smoking allowed upstairs.

name_ja: 焼きあご塩らー麺 たかはし 上野店
station: Ueno-Hirokoji / Ueno-Okachimachi Exit A5; JR Okachimachi 3 min
what_to_order: Yakiago shio ramen (salt ramen with grilled flying fish broth), then the ochazuke set with the leftover broth
tourist_tip: Cash only. No reservations. Open late. Part of a small ramen chain.

name_ja: 横濱ラーメン あさが家 上野店
what_to_order: Special ramen (marked as recommended by the shop)
tourist_tip: Opened March 2025. Open until 3:00 at night. Cards, IC cards and QR (PayPay, Alipay, WeChat Pay) accepted. Branch of an iekei chain.

what_to_order: Queen of Amber (house iced coffee drink), Bonaru blend coffee, cake
tourist_tip: Cash only. No reservations. Fully non-smoking. Moved here from Nihonbashi.

what_to_order: Chicken-salt tanmen with pork, or chicken shio ramen
tourist_tip: Lunch only. Cash only. No reservations.

station: Yushima (Chiyoda Line Exit 4); also Ueno-Hirokoji 3 min
hours: Shop: Tue-Sat 9:30-19:00, Sun 9:30-17:30, holidays 9:30-18:00. Tea room: 11:00-18:00 (last order 17:30)
closed_days: Monday and the day after a public holiday (tea room closing day may differ; check)
what_to_order: Daifuku, especially mame daifuku (rice cake studded with beans and filled with red bean paste)
tourist_tip: Takeout counter plus a 28-seat tea room. No reservations. Cards and QR payments (PayPay, Rakuten Pay, au PAY) accepted, but not IC cards. Sometimes sells at a stall inside Yushima Tenjin shrine.

name_ja: ぶどうパンとコーヒーの店 舞い鶴
what_to_order: Budo-pan (raisin bread), the shop's namesake
tourist_tip: Tiny shop: Retty lists 8 seats, but treat it mainly as takeout. No credit cards; PayPay accepted.

name_ja: 自家焙煎珈琲みじんこ
station: Yushima (Chiyoda Line); also JR Ochanomizu 6 min
hours: Mon-Fri 11:00-19:30; Sat, Sun & holidays 10:00-19:30 (food last order 18:30, drinks 19:00)
closed_days: None (open daily except New Year holidays; occasional closures for maintenance)
what_to_order: Hotcakes cooked on a copper griddle with house-roasted specialty coffee; also the pudding and the weekday lunch set
tourist_tip: Reservations only through the shop's own online booking site (not by phone or email). Cards and PayPay accepted, no IC cards. Closer to Ochanomizu side of Yushima.

name_ja: 旧岩崎邸庭園 お茶席
genre: Tea room (matcha and Japanese sweets) inside a historic garden
what_to_order: Matcha set with a Japanese sweet
tourist_tip: It is inside the Kyu-Iwasaki-tei Gardens, so you must pay garden admission first. Good rest stop after touring the Western-style mansion.

name_ja: 湯島ワンズラクレット
closed_days: Sunday and public holidays (Sunday lunch is served at the sister shop near Yushima Tenjin)
what_to_order: Raclette (melted cheese scraped over potatoes and other sides)
tourist_tip: Dinner only. Cards accepted (Visa, Master, JCB, Amex, Diners). Phone bookings accepted. 26 seats.

closed_days: Mainly Monday (check the shop's online calendar)
what_to_order: Kakigori (shaved ice) with seasonal syrups
tourist_tip: Cashless only: cards, IC cards and QR codes accepted, cash not accepted. No reservations; only 15 seats, so expect a wait in summer.

station: Ueno-Hirokoji (Ginza Line); also JR Okachimachi 2 min
closed_days: Not listed (Tabelog shows the same hours every day)
what_to_order: Kakigori (shaved ice) and parfaits such as the kinako (roasted soybean) parfait
tourist_tip: On the 1st floor of PARCO_ya Ueno; formerly named 'Kuriya otona Kuroki'. No reservations. Cards, IC cards and QR payments accepted. Not the same shop as the Akihabara restaurant Kyo Kuroki.

station: Keisei Ueno; also JR Ueno and Ueno-Hirokoji 3 min
what_to_order: Kabayaki (grilled eel) over rice, e.g. 'Kabayaki Gohan Take' (9,500 yen); the seasonal 'Koetsu' set (5,000 yen) is the cheaper option
tourist_tip: Facing Shinobazu Pond near Keisei Ueno. Cards accepted. 120 seats with private rooms. Phone and online bookings accepted.

genre: Japanese set meals (onigiri, teishoku); small dishes at night
what_to_order: Lunch sets (A lunch 850 yen, B lunch 980 yen, sashimi lunch 1,200 yen) and onigiri rice balls
tourist_tip: Cards and PayPay accepted. Takeout available. 28 seats incl. counter, non-smoking. Online booking available.

name_ja: 我流担々麺 竹子 天神下店
what_to_order: Tantanmen (sesame and chili noodle soup)
tourist_tip: Open until 5:30am Mon-Sat, useful late at night. Smoking allowed at all seats. No credit cards.

name_ja: Eagle Cafe（イーグル カフェ）
what_to_order: Coffee and sandwiches
tourist_tip: Small: 15 seats, non-smoking. No credit cards; PayPay accepted.

what_to_order: unknown
tourist_tip: Opens at 7:00, so it works for breakfast. Smoking allowed at all seats. Reported to be cash only.

what_to_order: Clover curry with vegetables, or with chicken cutlet and fried egg
tourist_tip: 2nd-floor shop with 12 seats incl. counter, non-smoking. No credit cards; PayPay accepted.

what_to_order: Shio (salt) ramen or tantanmen
tourist_tip: Very small: 6 counter seats plus some upstairs tables. No credit cards; PayPay accepted.

station: Ueno-Hirokoji (Ginza Line); also Keisei Ueno 2 min
what_to_order: Tiramisu latte (strawberry, matcha or espresso; 715 yen each) and the panda parfait
tourist_tip: Large cafe (76 seats incl. counter), non-smoking. Cards and IC cards accepted. Reservations, including online, accepted.

what_to_order: Yushima ramen (shoyu), the house namesake bowl
tourist_tip: Weekdays only. No credit cards; PayPay accepted. 23 seats incl. 9 at the counter.

what_to_order: Tsukemen (dipping noodles) or ramen
tourist_tip: Right next to Yushima Station. Closes at 19:00. Non-smoking. Payment methods not listed, so bring cash.

what_to_order: unknown
tourist_tip: Open every day. Amex and PayPay accepted. 22 table seats, non-smoking.

what_to_order: Mocha coffee and coffee jelly
tourist_tip: Hours are not published on the sources checked, so confirm before going. No credit cards. Non-smoking.

genre: Japanese kappo (suppon soft-shell turtle, eel, seasonal courses)
what_to_order: Seasonal set courses (about 9,800-14,400 yen); suppon (soft-shell turtle) is a specialty
tourist_tip: Online reservations accepted. Cards and PayPay accepted. 24 seats with counter and private rooms.

name_ja: エスニックキッチン＆バル BAIDAM
what_to_order: unknown
tourist_tip: Basement shop, 25 seats incl. counter. Cards and PayPay accepted. Phone and online bookings accepted. Separate smoking area.
